items.short_description: Misty tea hills, spice gardens and a night on a private houseboat — Kerala’s classics at an easy pace.
items.description:
Our best-selling Kerala holiday covers the hills of Munnar, the forests of Thekkady and the backwaters of Alleppey, with comfortable drives and handpicked hotels.

Day-by-day itinerary

Day 1: Arrive in Kochi

Pick-up from the airport, Fort Kochi walk and an evening Kathakali show.

Day 2: Kochi to Munnar

Drive past waterfalls and spice gardens into the tea hills.

Day 3: Munnar

Eravikulam National Park, tea museum and Mattupetty dam.

Day 4: Munnar to Thekkady

Spice plantation walk and an optional boat ride on Periyar lake.

Day 5: Thekkady to Alleppey

Board your private houseboat and cruise the backwaters with lunch and dinner on board.

Day 6: Departure

Disembark after breakfast and drive to Kochi airport.

data.heading: We started as travellers, and we still are
data.description:
Horizon Trails began in 2012 when two friends from Kochi started organising weekend trips for their colleagues. Today a team of 25 trip planners sends more than 1,500 travellers on holiday every year.

We are a Ministry of Tourism–approved tour operator and a member of the TravelSure Network.

data.content:
This policy explains how Horizon Trails collects and uses the personal information you share through this website.

Information we collect

Your name, phone number, email address, travel dates and preferences when you send an enquiry or book a trip. For bookings we also collect traveller names and, where needed, passport details.

How we use it

Only to plan and book your trip, and to share it with hotels, airlines and transport partners who need it to provide your services. We never sell your data.

Your choices

Write to us to correct or delete your information at any time.

Bookings

A booking is confirmed when we receive the advance payment and send a confirmation. Prices are subject to availability and may change until confirmation.

Payments

A 25% advance confirms the booking; the balance is due 21 days before departure.

Changes

Hotel or route changes after confirmation may cost extra. We are not responsible for delays caused by weather, strikes or other events beyond our control.

• 30 days or more before departure: full refund minus ₹2,500 per person.
  • 15–29 days before departure: 50% of the package price is refunded.
  • Less than 15 days before departure: no refund.

Flight tickets, visas and non-refundable hotel bookings are refunded according to the supplier’s rules.
